core_obligations: Algebraicity and spacehood: the quotient stack is algebraic, and since the relation embeds as a monomorphism it has no automorphisms, so the quotient is in fact an algebraic space (proof lines 7261-7270)

Flatness and finite presentation: the covering is surjective flat and locally of finite presentation, so flatness and local finite presentation transfer to the quotient over the base (proof lines 7271-7278)

Openness of the diagonal: in the displayed cartesian square the right vertical arrow is surjective flat and of finite presentation, so the property that the top horizontal arrow is an open immersion descends to the diagonal of the quotient, which is therefore an open immersion (proof lines 7279-7292)
Conclusion: an unramified flat morphism of finite presentation is etale, so the quotient is etale over the base (proof lines 7293-7296)
proof_roadmap: 由平坦群胚定理 [U/R] 是代数栈；R → U × U 是单态射 ⇒ 无自同构 ⇒ [U/R] 是代数空间 X。
U → X 满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ X → Y 平坦且局部有限表现。
在方块 R → U ×_Y U、X → X ×_Y X 中右垂直箭头满平坦局部有限表现，故上水平箭头的开浸入性下降到 Δ_X：X → X ×_Y X 是开浸入 ⇒ X → Y unramified。
unramified + 平坦 + 局部有限表现 ⇒ étale。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a flat finitely presented groupoid in algebraic spaces over a base, with the relation embedding into the square of the covering as an open immersion, has an algebraic space quotient which is etale over the base (author lemma at source lines 7251-7259, label lemma-quotient-etale). The proof (source lines 7261-7297) uses the flat groupoid theorem, deduces that the quotient is an algebraic space from the absence of automorphisms, transfers flatness and finite presentation through the covering, identifies the diagonal of the quotient with the given open immersion by the covering criterion and concludes by the unramified-flat-finite-presentation criterion for etaleness (proof lines 7261-7296). The identification of the diagonal with the given open immersion is the substance. H3.
